content: Framer Motion will-change is reference-counted per property via WillChangeMotionValue. Layout animations bypass will-change entirely (animate progress 0-1000, not CSS props). Key performance pitfalls: layout animations trigger layout thrashing on mobile; animating width/height/top/left forces reflow; AnimatePresence has overhead for simple transitions. Always use transform and opacity for 60fps. Layout animation ancestors can cancel optimized appear animations. Need prefers-reduced-motion support.
